source.name: Guts
source.originalDescription: When Larvitar receives damage equal to at least 10% of max HP, Attack is increased by 30% for 3s. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered (40s cd).
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Guts は 攻撃・特攻などのステータスを変化させる。

source.name: Bite
source.originalDescription: Deals damage to enemies in front of the user. If the enemy HP is below 50%—or falls below that percentage as a result of this move—they become immobilized for 0.6s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Bite は 移動不能を付与する。

source.name: Rock Polish
source.originalDescription: Charge ahead in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemies hit. If this move hits any enemy, all damage is increased by 15% for 3s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rock Polish には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

source.name: Tyrannical Rampage
source.originalDescription: Briefly becomes unstoppable and explodes with anger, then goes on a rampage for 10s, gaining 50% tenacity for the duration. While rampaging, changes the auto attack pattern, dealing increased damage. Damaging a Pokémon from the opposing team below 20% max HP with these auto attacks deals 40% max HP as true damage to the target (sufficient damage reduction effects can prevent the target from being knocked out). Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Tyrannical Rampage は 妨害無効になる、受けるダメージを軽減する、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。
